site_model.pv: Open-Meteo Solar Forecast for a 10 kW system (3.6 kWp east, 6.4 kWp west, 10 kW inverter) at the Green's home location; 0 W at night
site_model.note: Site values are computed from the model's mean values at the CSMS-measured EV power, before the +/-5% random variation; the live site meter is published on MQTT every 10 s and is not recorded in Home Assistant.

dispatch.rule: Each requested setpoint is clamped to the site headroom of its period. Charge headroom = import limit + 0.95 x solar - 1.05 x house load. Discharge headroom = export limit - (1.05 x solar - 0.95 x house load): solar has priority on export, and house load the solar does not cover absorbs discharge too.
